name: (RAPID MINIGUN) Artificial Warfare
desc:
!! PRIVATE SERVERS ARE HEAVILY RECOMMENDED !!
!! NPC LIMIT COUNT SCALES OFF OF HEALTH IN PUBLIC SERVERS ONLY !!

Create your own NPCs that are able to engage in combat, or talk with each other!

This game uses text generation to write dialog for your NPCs, they're NOT HUMAN!

-- Update Log
- Artificial Warfare is now available to play globally!
- Added new legendary power, "Switcher!"

Private Servers get exclusive content!
- Current commands: /clearallnpcs, /buildingtools, /spawnpad (NPCNAME) (Rate) (Limit), /clearallspawnpads
- 3x Power Slots!
- Damage Multiplier!
- Unlimited Health!
- SpawnPads!
- Fixed NPC Population Count!

How to play:
Open the "NPC Menu" on the bottom left and load in your NPCs. Then press the configure icon to start making your own NPC!

Topics of the game include:
AI War, NPC Fight, AI Battle, NPC Battle, NPC War, AI Fight.

Credits:
res - Scripting, UIs.
MoIitor - UV Mapping Meshes.
Many other contributors who have helped by making maps! Thank you!
